# `Browser.Orientation`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Browser.Orientation — a session-stream delivering `deviceorientation`
events as typed alpha/beta/gamma readings, over `Ipe.Ffi.Js` ports.

A first-party proof of the per-capability web mechanism spanning BOTH port
directions: an outbound `JsCmd` starts or stops the orientation watch, and
inbound `JsMsg` frames carry typed orientation readings. Both cross the same
seal codec and fail-closed port discipline as every other port; there is no
second transport.

Importing this reserved `Ipe.Browser.<Api>` module discloses
`js-port:orientation` (import-derived, keyed on the canonical
`Ipe.Browser.Orientation` path prefix via `WebCapability::for_browser_module`,
alias-immune); only the top-level app's `[capabilities] accepts` set can grant
it.

The two layers:

  * `Ipe.Browser.Orientation.Internals` publishes the closed outbound/inbound ADTs.
  * this module is the high-level layer: `watch` starts the continuous stream
    as an outbound `Cmd`, `stopWatch` ends it, and `readings` is the inbound
    subscription folding the narrow `JsMsg` into a typed `OrientationEvent`.
    The inbound `case` is EXHAUSTIVE: an unavailability becomes a typed variant,
    never a silently dropped frame.

## `OrientationEvent`

A typed orientation event delivered by the watch stream.

  * `OrientationReading alpha beta gamma` — a `deviceorientation` event.
    `alpha` is rotation around the Z axis (0.0..360.0 degrees); `beta` is
    rotation around the X axis (-180.0..180.0 degrees); `gamma` is rotation
    around the Y axis (-90.0..90.0 degrees). Values are `Maybe` because the
    browser may deliver `null` for axes not supported by the device.
  * `OrientationUnavailable` — the `deviceorientation` event is absent in
    this browser context.

## `watch`

```ipe
watch : Cmd.Cmd msg
```

`watch` — begin a continuous `deviceorientation` stream; readings are
delivered on the `readings` subscription. Outbound `Cmd`.

The JS host attaches a `deviceorientation` listener on `window`. A missing
event replies immediately with `Unavailable` rather than silently failing.

Importing this module discloses `js-port:orientation`; the app must grant it
with `accepts = [ JsPort Orientation ]` under [capabilities] in package.ipe.

## `stopWatch`

```ipe
stopWatch : Cmd.Cmd msg
```

`stopWatch` — remove the active `deviceorientation` listener. A no-op when
no watch is active. Outbound `Cmd`.

## `readings`

```ipe
readings : (OrientationEvent -> msg) -> Sub.Sub msg
```

`readings toMsg` — the inbound subscription, wired in `subscriptions`.

The decoder IS the security gate: every inbound value runs through the total,
bounded seal decoder for the narrow `JsMsg`; a malformed / mismatched frame is
dropped whole. A decoded `JsMsg` is folded EXHAUSTIVELY into an
`OrientationEvent` — every variant is covered, so no reading can ever be
silently dropped.
